`include "disciplines.vams"
module dut(u,y,count); input u; output y,count; electrical u,y,count; real q,next; integer n; analog begin @(initial_step) begin q=0; next=0.5; n=0; end
 @(cross(V(u)-0.4,1,1e-12,1e-12)) begin q=1-q; n=n+1; end
 V(y)<+0.5*V(y)+transition(q,0,0.08,0.12); V(count)<+n; end endmodule

`include "disciplines.vams"
module dut(u,e,y,mark,count); input u; output e,y,mark,count; electrical u,e,y,mark,count; real s,q; analog begin
 @(initial_step) begin s=0; q=0; end
 @(timer(0.25,0,1e-12)) s=1;
 @(timer(0.375,0,1e-12)) begin if(V(e)>1.4) q=0.75; else q=0; end
 V(e)<+1+transition(s,0,0.25,0.25); V(y)<+transition(q,0,0.125,0.125);
 V(mark)<+q; V(count)<+s; end endmodule

`include "disciplines.vams"
module dut(u,e,y,mark,count); input u; inout e,mark; output y,count; electrical u,e,y,mark,count; real a,b; analog begin
 @(initial_step) begin a=0; b=0; end
 @(cross(V(u)-1,+1,1e-9,1e-9)) begin a=1; b=1; end
 @(timer(0.5,0,1e-9)) begin a=2; b=2.0000000000000004; end
 V(e)<+transition(a,0,0.75,0.75); V(mark)<+transition(b,0,0.75,0.75);
 V(y)<+V(e)+V(mark); V(count)<+a; end endmodule
